questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The world's most expensive restaurants
How to cook traditional Indian food
Why food prices are rising around the world
A project that helps people cook healthy food cheaply
questions.why: They discuss 'Bags of Taste', which helps people save money on food and improve their diet.

questions.q: How does Pippa save money on her food shopping?
options: She only buys food on sale
She shops online
She plans what she's going to cook
She eats at restaurants much less than she used to
questions.why: Pippa says she plans what she likes to cook so she doesn't waste money.

questions.q: What does Pippa think of Georgie's shopping habit?
options: It's a terrible idea to shop when hungry
It's a good way to save money
It's the same as her own habit
It's healthy because snacks are cheaper than proper meals
questions.why: Georgie shops when hungry and buys snacks, and Pippa says, 'that's a terrible idea'.

questions.q: What worried Alicia Weston, the founder of Bags of Taste?
options: Supermarkets were wasting too much food
People with less money had the worst diets and got ill younger
Children were no longer learning how to cook healthy food at school
Restaurants were becoming too expensive
questions.why: She says people in poverty are eating the worst diets and 'getting sicker younger'.

questions.q: Which problem did Alicia find that stopped people cooking healthy meals?
options: They didn't have kitchens
They couldn't afford to risk wasting ingredients by cooking badly
They didn't like vegetables
They preferred eating at restaurants or buying cheap fast food instead
questions.why: People didn't know how to cook the meals and couldn't afford to experiment and waste food.

questions.q: Why does Bags of Taste deliver ingredients to people's homes?
options: Because most people say they don't have enough time to go shopping
Because supermarkets are far away
To make the ingredients cheaper
Because Alicia believes change begins with behaviour at home
questions.why: She says 'behaviour change starts with actually changing your behaviour at home'.

questions.q: What does the mentor in each WhatsApp group do?
options: Delivers the food bags
Checks how much money people spend
Shares cooking tips and advice
Cooks the meals for participants
questions.why: Each group has a mentor who shares cooking tips and advice.

questions.q: What happened when participant Ally made her chana masala?
options: She used too much chilli and will use less next time
She burned it and had to start again
Her husband said it wasn't nearly spicy enough and added more chilli
She couldn't find the onion in her bag
questions.why: She was 'a bit too heavy-handed with the chilli' and would reduce it next time.
